title: FactoryLM vendor-neutral CMMS write contract v1 (#5020)
description: Language-neutral twin of mira-hub/src/lib/cmms/write-contract.ts. A provider adapter (Atlas first, in-memory mock second, Python mira-mcp adapters later) reports support per operation and per target at runtime, returns exactly one closed-set outcome per write, and never treats a legacy error dict or an empty body as success. Delivery is at-least-once with explicit deduplication on the marker; outcome_unknown is reconciled by read-back, never by a blind second write.
